objective: Assess all 20 configured competitions separately. Priority is the first score, then ordered three-score coverage, WDL and actual Asian totals full wins, on complete first-issued populations.
signal: Read only prior-date paired regulation shots on target. Keep each competition and exact panel stage independent. Accumulate decayed team/against shots per match and goals per eligible shot, and phase-wide home/away levels. Use the existing competition half-life, 8 pseudo team matches, 40 pseudo finishing shots, phase initial home/away shots 4.5/3.8 and conversion 0.30. If goals exceed shots for a side, retain the shot count and omit that side from conversion estimation. Goals divided by shots is a box-score proxy. Both teams need some prior paired-shot history to alter the forecast. Missing target-match box scores do not exclude a match.
distribution: Predict shot volume from venue and the geometric mean of the home/away teams' relative attack and allowance. Given the chronological unfitted R7 anchor mean for each side, fit two ridge Poisson slopes (penalty 16, bounds [-1,1]) for log shot-volume times phase conversion relative to anchor and log team/opponent conversion relative to phase. Clip each feature to +/-1.25. Estimate signed home/away shot-volume residual covariance from training pairs, shrink by n/(n+60) and bound the implied two-state fractional shock at 0.35. The two equally weighted states share a pace factor for positive covariance and favour opposite sides for negative covariance. Transfer the likelihood ratio to the R7 full matrix. Record the fixed full and mean-only arms.
selection: For each competition use only the chronological validation block to choose probability-mixture intensity in {0,0.5,1}. For the score head order by Top1 hits, Top3 hits, lower score log loss, then smaller dose. WDL selects by direction hits, then smaller dose. Actual OU selects by whole wins on issued real lines excluding pushes, then smaller dose. Zero or unsupported heads inherit their original controls. Score quality and direction quality use their corresponding heads.
archive: Identical R7/R9 main and recent calendars and fixtures. Original R7, R9, issued market, and same-runtime R7 control. Compare all four KPIs, five settlements, exposure, rank rescues and losses, and paired date-cluster intervals. Never use an observed result from the target date to form shot features. Original historical market first-known times are often unknown.
independent: Six European domestic leagues eng.1, esp.1, ger.1, ita.1, fra.1, ned.1. Football-data.co.uk 2015/16 and 2016/17 fit; 2017/18 validation; 2018/19 test. Refit R7 and R10 from window-local history. This season is an additional test of this recipe. It is not evidence of a past real-time forecast.
afc: A separate Elite-only calendar fits all available 2024/25, validates on 2025/26 and tests on 2026/27 through completed, verified fixtures up to the collection cutoff. Split out results after 2026-10-12 (the old R7 panel end). Run a time-refitted R7 control on identical history. No secondary ACL, older ACL format, extra-time box scores or unverified opponent joins. For the forward AFC arm use the refreshed Elite model and compare both the local refreshed baseline and the original issued R7/R9.
forward: Use the still-unstarted R9 registered slate and identical frozen market prices. Keep separately verified identity conflicts visible. Refit coefficients on all finished panel records; validation-selected doses are fixed. Save one ordered three-score selection, independent WDL and quoted Asian OU heads, identity and source hashes. No automatic active promotion. An improvement to claim requires out-of-time and prospective same-fixture evidence under project rules.
